ablation: delete every 2-cell from every checkpoint; retain all vertices/edges and original scores
identity: W=sum Z_k(L_s) contains B_k(U), since the boundary of each (k+1)-cell lies in a checkpoint containing that cell. Hence S=W/B_k(U), H_k(U)/S is isomorphic to Z_k(U)/W, and alpha=dim Z_k(U)-dim W. Alpha_k depends only on checkpoint k-skeleta.
